line.en: sunrise is about 07:05 on tuesday and the sky is forecast mostly clear. climb namsan from 06:00 and be at the top before the light comes.
line.de: der sonnenaufgang ist am dienstag gegen 07:05 und der himmel soll größtenteils klar sein. steig ab 06:00 auf den namsan und sei vor dem licht oben.
line.tr: salı günü gündoğumu yaklaşık 07:05'te ve gökyüzü büyük ölçüde açık olacak. 06:00'dan itibaren namsan'a çık, ışık gelmeden tepede ol.

sparks.why: Sunrise at 07:05 on tue 10 nov for seoul (vedpanchang.com); KMA medium-range forecast of 1 Nov shows mostly clear skies from mon to wed.
